Why women choose The Career Strategy Group Marketplace

Women already make up the majority of coaching clients, and demand keeps growing. Among those who work with a coach, clients report real gains in confidence, productivity, and work-life balance. Yet women still receive less career support than men: McKinsey's 2025 research found they're less likely to have a sponsor, and employees with one are promoted at nearly twice the rate.

We make it dramatically easier for women to find trusted, qualified coaches who understand the unique challenges women face, what they are trying to accomplish, and how to get them there.

What we cover

Coaches who specialize in exactly what you need

Our coaches specialize in a wide range of topics, from job search strategy to launching a business.

🧠

Learn job search strategies

Learn proven tactics to navigate a challenging job market, including where to focus your energy, how to network with intention, and how to get in front of decision-makers, so you can land a job faster.

This is for you if you've been thinking:
"I've applied to 100 jobs and heard nothing back"
"I don't know how to get noticed anymore"
"My network feels ice cold"
🦋

Explore a new career

Get clear on what's next, whether that's a new industry, a new function, or a completely different path, and build a realistic plan to make it happen.

This is for you if you've been thinking:
"Am I even in the right field?"
"I want to do something that actually fits who I am now"
"Could I really start over at this stage?"
🎤

Ace my interview & negotiate my salary

Answer tough questions, sharpen your stories, show up confidently in interviews, and walk in ready to close (and get more money, to boot!) with the help of a coach who knows what makes a candidate stand out.

This is for you if you've been thinking:
"I always blank on the tough interview questions"
"I don't know how to talk about salary without feeling awkward"
"I want to negotiate but I'm scared to push my luck"
📋

Get feedback on my resume

Already have a resume? Get an expert's read on what's working and what might trap your resume in the ATS black hole, before you hit send.

Why us

Why we're different

Coaches who understand how women thrive

Every coach has a track record of helping women at every level build success on their own terms, be it getting that promotion, doing more meaningful work, or having a greater impact in the world.

A coach for every chapter

Today it might be landing a job. In a year, it could be negotiating a promotion or stepping into leadership. Come back anytime and we'll match you with the right expert for what's next in your life or your career.

Try it for the price of one hour

Begin with a single session, no package or upfront membership required. Fit matters. A lot. Find the right coach for you and go at a pace (and within a budget) that works for you.

Backed by our rematch guarantee

If your first session isn't the right fit, tell us within 48 hours. We'll help you pick a new coach and take 50% off your first session with them. One rematch per client; the credit is good for 90 days. We know that fit matters, and we care about getting it right for you.

Employer-friendly

We give you simple documentation, so you can easily tap your company's professional-development budget or get reimbursed through HR.

Never one-size-fits-all

From landing your first role to stepping into the C-suite, coaches are matched to your specific stage and goal. Ours is never a one-size-fits-all program.

The story behind it

Finding a qualified coach isn't hard. Finding the right one is.

After 25+ years helping people navigate their careers, I've seen firsthand what happens when a woman gets the right coach at the right moment: the confidence to ask for what she's worth, the clarity to make a bold pivot, the push to finally go after the role she's wanted all along.

So I built the marketplace I wished I'd had for my own clients: a curated group of coaches who understand your industry, your stage, and what it's really like to build a career as a woman. Every coach here is vetted against the same high standard, so you can skip the guesswork and get straight to the work that matters. I've spent my career recruiting for major companies, coaching thousands of professionals through career pivots, and building my own business from the ground up, and I built this marketplace to put all of that in your corner.

I also know that no single coach can help you get everything you want out of this life. That's why I've always kept a trusted team of coaches around me, people I refer my own clients to whenever they need a different kind of support. I wanted to build something that brings all of that together under one roof, so you're never left wondering where to turn next.

And we stand by our promise with our rematch guarantee: if your first session isn't the right fit, tell us within 48 hours. We'll help you pick a new coach and take 50% off your first session with them. One rematch per client; the credit is good for 90 days.

Helping women accomplish more, and get there faster than they thought possible, is the work of my life. Whatever brought you here today, I'm just glad you came, and I can't wait to see what we accomplish together.

Laura M. Labovich
Founder & Chief Executive Officer

FAQs

How are coaches chosen?

Every expert goes through our proprietary vetting process, a formula built from years of recruiting and coaching experience that weighs real client outcomes, credentials, and coaching approach, not just a resume. We look for experienced coaches with proven success helping women grow, succeed, and thrive. It's one of the things that sets this marketplace apart: we don't just list coaches, we handpick them.

How do sessions work?

At the time of purchase, you may choose to have your session via phone call or video call; it's your choice.

How much does it cost?

Pricing varies based on coach's experience and expertise.

How do I know which coach is right for me?

Take our 2-minute quiz and we'll match you with coaches suited to your situation, goals, level, and industry. Every coach's profile also shows their specialties, experience, and pricing, so you can review with confidence before you book.

Can my employer pay for this?

Many clients use their company's professional-development budget or get reimbursed through HR. Upon request, we can provide you with a receipt for services, so your reimbursement is easy. Just Contact Us to request this information!

Do you offer a guarantee?

Yes — our rematch guarantee. If your first session isn't the right fit, tell us within 48 hours. We'll help you pick a new coach and take 50% off your first session with them. One rematch per client; the credit is good for 90 days.

Can I work with more than one coach, or switch specialties later?

Yes. Careers change, and so can your coach. Come back anytime, whether that's in a few weeks or a few years, and we'll match you with the right expert for where you're headed.
